text:
elena: Hey team — Private/VPC on-prem is entering GA rollout for limited customers next week :tada:. This release includes:
- Private control plane (VPC peering & customer-managed subnets)
- KMS/HSM integration for keys (:lock:)
- Audit log export and enhanced retention controls
- Updated compliance pack: SOC2 + ISO attestation docs available

Docs & checklist: https://redwood.internal/private-ga (internal)

Quick notes: please read the upgrade/compatibility section — rolling upgrades require at most one small config flag change. More below.

raj: Nice — engineering notes on upgrade path:
- If you're on the v0.9 private agent, run:
```bash
helm repo add redwood https://helm.redwood.ai/charts
helm upgrade --install redwood-agent redwood/private-agent --version 1.0.0 -f values.yaml
```
- Values to watch: `controlPlane.mode=private`, `kms.provider=external`
- We've added a migration job that converts existing secrets to the new envelope format (non-blocking).

amanda: Solutions / onboarding checklist (for SEs prepping customers):
- Customer signed RA/SA and network peering request
- Confirm KMS/HSM vendor and key policy (we currently support AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, and Thales Luna)
- Confirm audit export destination (S3/GCS/HTTP endpoint)
- Book 1-hr enablement session with eng-oncall + prod-ops
- Proposed early access customers: acme-fin, safehealth, fintech-saas — pinging @raj for capacity planning

sean: Security note: HSM integrations will require customer-provided key policies. We performed integration testing with Thales; Azure and AWS KMS tested too. Customers requiring FedRAMP-level controls should speak with compliance — we have a checklist but FedRAMP authorization is customer-specific. :shield:

ops-bot: deploy update: private-agent v1.0.0 image pushed to registry at 1715001200, canary pipelines triggered :rocket:

k8s-deploy-bot: Canary deploys passed on staging (3/3), metrics look good (p90 CPU and mem within thresholds). No rollback triggers in last 30m.

elena: Action items:
- Raj: confirm capacity for the three EA customers this week
- Amanda: schedule the enablement sessions and share final checklist in this thread
- Sean: attach KMS vendor docs to the public checklist

If anyone sees compliance blockers or customer-specific blockers, escalate to @oncall and drop them here. Thanks team! :clap:
